description.value:
Slot none; Price 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 1 sp

You may cause an instantaneous talent that affects an area to persist until the beginning of your next turn. Those already in the area suffer no additional harm, but other creatures or objects entering the area are subject to its effects. A lingering talent with a visual manifestation obscures vision, providing concealment (20% miss chance) beyond 5 feet and total concealment (50% miss chance) beyond 20 feet.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Lingering Spell; Cost 2,500 gp (lesser), 5,000 gp (normal), 10,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Use as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect while holding this apparatus in at least one hand. The effect must be caster level seven or lower. Spend one of 3 daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat’s extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

Only an instantaneous area effect qualifies, persisting until the start of the next turn. Creatures already in the area take no additional harm; new entrants are affected. A visual manifestation grants concealment beyond five feet and total concealment beyond twenty feet.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
